reason: An agent-facing integration that discovers, describes, validates, and calls administrator-configured OpenAPI 3.x APIs with method, destination, credential, redirect, and response-size controls.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供发现、描述和调用管理员配置的 OpenAPI 3.x API 的结构化工具。
summaries.en: Provides agents with structured tools to discover, describe, validate, and call administrator-configured OpenAPI 3.x APIs.

capabilities: Discovers operations from administrator-configured OpenAPI 3.x documents
Describes API operation parameters, request bodies, servers, and responses
Invokes configured API operations over HTTP(S)
Uses environment-backed credentials for request headers
Reads local or remote OpenAPI specification sources
Restricts methods, destinations, redirects, and response sizes according to configuration
